defs.def: that is near or around sth 周围的；附近的

ex.s: If you’re among the groups of people who are enjoying the mental and physical health benefits of surrounding yourself with plants, don’t beat yourself up if one (or a few!) doesn’t make it.
ex.t: 如果你也属于那些正享受被植物环绕带来的身心益处的人群，即便有一株（或几株！）没能养活，也别苛责自己。

ex.s: In addition, there’s no need for pesticides and other chemicals that pollute traditional farms and the surrounding environment.
ex.t: 此外，也不需要那些会污染传统农场及周边环境的有毒农药和其他化学品。

ex.s: “There was once a town in the heart of America, ___44___ all life seemed to enjoy peaceful existence with is surroundings,” her fable begins, ___45___ (borrow) some familiar words from many age-old fables.
ex.t: “从前，在美国的心脏地带有一座小镇，___44___那里所有的生命似乎都与其周围环境和平安宁地共存，”她的寓言这样开头，___45___（borrow）借用了许多古老寓言中一些熟悉的字句。

ex.s: When Lisa moved to a new city, she had a hard time ________ to her new surroundings.
ex.t: 当丽莎搬到一个新城市时，她很难（第__空）适应新环境。

ex.s: （4）Why do the hikers take no notice of the surroundings during the journey？
ex.t: (4) 徒步旅行者为何在旅途中不注意周围环境?

ex.s: Soil surrounding the sequoia in its original location was relocated as well, because trees are more likely to survive a transplant when they move with their original soil.
ex.t: 红杉原址周围的土壤也一并迁移，因为带着原土移植，树更可能存活。

ex.s: Determining where we are _________our surroundings remains an essential skill for our survival.
ex.t: 确定我们在环境中所处的位置，仍然是我们生存的一项基本技能。

ex.s: Settings: time, location and descriptions of the environment or surroundings help your readers picture the scene.
ex.t: 设置:时间,位置以及环境或周围环境的描述帮助读者描绘场景.

ex.s: Not only do they provide us with food, clothes and oxygen to breathe, but they also make our surroundings more beautiful.
ex.t: 它们不仅为我们提供食物、衣服和呼吸的氧气，还让我们的环境更美丽。

ex.s: When Riley moves to a new city, she has a hard time adjusting to her new surroundings.
ex.t: 当莱莉搬到一个新城市，她很难适应新环境。

ex.s: He did field research across China and studied more than a thousand rivers and streams, along with the landscape, history and culture of the surrounding areas.
ex.t: 他在中国各地进行了实地研究,研究了1000多条河流和溪流,同时研究了周边地区的景观,历史和文化.

ex.s: Three -dimensional (3D) animation means that viewers can see the characters move around and interact with their surroundings.
ex.t: 三维(3D)动画意味着观众可以看到角色在周围移动并与周围环境互动.
